events.name: Curtain Call From Beyond: Theatre Haunts & History
events.info: On this 50-minute guided walking tour, guests will wander through backstage corridors and performance spaces while hearing behind-the-scenes theatre stories, local ghost lore, and fascinating history connected to the building. Each ticket also includes access to The Lounge, Martin Marietta Center's hospitality space featuring gothic-inspired décor, candlelight, and moody touches, along with one signature alcoholic or non-alcoholic drink per person. Please note, this tour is recommended for ages 12 and up. Accessible tour routes are available on October 4th and October 25th at 7:00pm.

Prohibited items include: outside food and beverage, camera bags, large purses (over 12"x12"x10"), backpacks, and weapons of any kind. generalInfo.childRule: Age 2 and older typically require a ticket, however this may vary by event. This information will be listed on the Ticketmaster event purchase page.

events.name: Curtain Call From Beyond: Theatre Haunts & History
events.info: On this 50-minute guided walking tour, guests will wander through backstage corridors and performance spaces while hearing behind-the-scenes theatre stories, local ghost lore, and fascinating history connected to the building. Each ticket also includes access to The Lounge, Martin Marietta Center's hospitality space featuring gothic-inspired décor, candlelight, and moody touches, along with one signature alcoholic or non-alcoholic drink per person. Please note, this tour is recommended for ages 12 and up. Accessible tour routes are available on October 4th and October 25th at 7:00pm.

events.name: Carolina Ballet presents Dracula
events.info: This two-act world premiere delves into the man who came before the legend. Once a loyal servant of the church, he leaves his new bride to fight in its name. When false news of his death reaches home, her longing of reunification comes at the cost of her life. Returning home only to find his beloved gone, he renounces his faith. At this crossroad of ruin, Dracula is born. In search of newfound devotion, this world premiere blends gothic with a deeply human depiction of adoration, piety, and deception. Dracula will feature both the power and nuance of our full company alongside a novel score.
